summary: Full E2E test of Aftersales 'Customer Quote PDF & Portal Acceptance' (Task 1, P0). Backend pytest: 9/9 pass covering build-quote-from-estate save, CRM PDF, mint portal-link (draft->sent), public GET (redacted view), public PDF, accept (agreement PF-MA-... created_by 'portal:...', quote portal_status=accepted), double-accept 410, decline-after-accept 410, decline flow + accept-after-decline 410. Frontend: CRM Aftersales Contracts -> Agreements sub-tab shows Customer quotes card with rows, PDF & Copy link buttons; Create link surfaces URL. Public /aq/<shortcode>: all testids present (page, quote-number, lines, totals, pdf, accept-section, name, signature-pad, accept-btn, decline-btn). Accept flow with drawn signature -> accepted-confirmation; reload shows confirmation only (no form). Decline flow -> decline-section -> declined-confirmation. All 12 acceptance criteria met.

issues: The 'Your name' input inside the decline section has no data-testid (accept section has afs-public-name but decline section reuses a separate un-tested input). Confirm-decline button is disabled until it is filled; consider adding data-testid='afs-public-decline-name' to make E2E deterministic.

After acceptance/decline, on reload the page renders only the confirmation card without the outer afs-public-page wrapper testid. Confirmation testid still visible so functionally OK, but wrapping the confirmation state under afs-public-page would keep test selectors consistent.

Public endpoints correctly redact CRM-only fields (no internal ids/notes leaking).
Agreement created_by starts with 'portal:' — clear audit trail for portal-originated agreements.
